name: Museum Ludwig
notes: Museum Ludwig beside Cologne Cathedral, from published descriptions; no photographs were available, and the ground file leaves the site empty. Busmann + Haberer's building (1986), shared with the Philharmonie beneath Heinrich-Böll-Platz: dark red brick over a stone base, tall slit windows, and its roofline, two ranks of curved zinc sheds rising to north-light glazing; the brick stair and lift towers; the glass entrance porch toward the cathedral; the terraces stepping down to the Rhine garden and the river on the east; the square over the concert hall, and the railway to the Hohenzollern Bridge on its viaduct to the north. Guessed: the footprint (about 110 by 84 m), the number and direction of the curved roofs, heights, the towers. The cathedral itself lies off the plate to the west.
